verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in assistant inside Orama to which a user can delegate tasks. AnswerSession is an API developers use to build ChatGPT-like experiences on their own websites, the JavaScript runtime is for building agents, and the MCP server lets external assistants such as ChatGPT or Cursor reach project data. These are developer building blocks or client-side integrations, not an in-product assistant that takes on the user's tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
